invariants: INV-GOV-CHECKPOINT-REMOTE-VERIFIED: Checkpoint must not declare REMOTE_DURABLE before live remote ref confirmation.
INV-GOV-CHECKPOINT-TREE-BINDING: Declared source and result blob SHAs must match git ls-tree exactly.

provisions.statement: Completed functional changes must be captured in sealed remote file checkpoints bound to commit SHA and capsule.
Live verification must evaluate remote branch durability and detect ancestor/descendant relationships.

scope: Remote durability checkpoints (CHK-*.json), remote ref verification, Git tree blob binding, and recovery semantics.
title: Synthesis Remote File Checkpoint and Durability Protocol Contract
